zoe.sre: FYI we're doing a rolling KV-prefix eviction to clear stale prefixes and improve long-tail cold-starts. Window: 2026-05-10 02:00-02:20 UTC. This will evict small-percentage prefixes per AZ to avoid thundering re-warm.
mike.runtime: Plan: staggered evict across AZs, 30s pause between prefix groups, total ~12m of active evictions, then 8m warm observation. Canary in eu-west-1 at 01:55 for 5m.
anna.prod: Any customer-visible risk? Dedicated/private?
zoe.sre: No API changes. Dedicated pools not touched unless tenant opted into shared prefix cleanup. Private deployments unaffected. We'll notify tenants if they opted in.
ops-bot: Calendar updated: KV-prefix eviction job scheduled -> job=kv-evict-20260510, initiator=zoe.sre
sre-oncall: Runbook (short):
1) Start canary eu-west-1 01:55 UTC, monitor token-latency/p99 and kv-miss-rate.
2) If p99 increases >200ms above baseline for >2m OR kv-miss-rate spikes >5x -> abort job and restore prefixes: `kv-evict rollback kv-evict-20260510`
3) After full run, observe 10m warm window then mark job complete.
mike.runtime: Exclude loadtests and bench runs: use header `x-internal-test=true` or tag `perf` to be ignored by metrics.
anna.prod: We'll post a short note on infra-status and notify platform teams.
zoe.sre: TL;DR: KV-prefix rolling eviction 2026-05-10 02:00-02:20 UTC, canary 01:55, staggered per-AZ eviction with short pauses, exclusion for perf runs, rollback conditions in runbook. Ping here to join the bridge.
anna.prod: ack :white_check_mark:
